epic.title: Deficiency cleanup after epic #567
epic.intent_and_why: Reconcile observed defects with current code and complete bounded repairs before choosing the remaining one-spine architecture.

definition_of_done: Wave 1 bounded repairs are implemented and independently reviewed.
Wave 2 residual implementation and architecture evidence are ready at the human checkpoint.
Every observed defect and related open issue has an explicit disposition.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Regression evidence at the public seam and independent review for every implementation lane.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Targeted tests plus the repository verification commands named by each Commander.
good_enough.appetite: Two bounded AFK waves ending before architecture selection or external publication.

hard_constraints: Do not mutate GitHub, push, open pull requests, merge to main, or choose an architecture before the checkpoint.
Preserve unrelated user changes in the main checkout.
Run #636 before #613 because both edit scripts/run_crew.py.
fixed_decisions: Route #639 into epic #572 and retain #575 as its Windows proof obligation.
Wave 1 contains #500, #636, and only the mechanical closeout half of #638.
Wave 2 may implement residual #613 and produce architecture evidence, but may not implement the architecture choice.

current_wave.objective: Close the epic: everything merged to main, every issue dispositioned, closeout recorded.
exit_criteria: All implementation lanes merged to main and the ordinary suite green there.
Every defect-ledger item and related issue dispositioned.

issues.title: Stop the engine instructing an agent to resume a dead plan, and remove two pieces of friction
issues.desired_outcome: The read and rail surfaces stop asserting liveness they cannot back; a cross-session waive is one call; --parent is required and documented.
issues.useful_now: It closes the defect the epic actually found, which no architecture candidate addressed.
issues.appetite: One bounded Implementer lane plus independent review, on the post-map integration base.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A dead plan renders HELD plus an age with no rail; SessionStart injects no resume order for a stale spine; the waiver is still journaled; the recovery verbs still work with no --parent; the ordinary suite is green.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the smallest change at each site; display only, no new subsystem.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not demote the lease (option C, retired as dominated).
Do not add a refusal on today's liveness signal.

uncertainty_register.unknown: Whether one-spine elimination or explicit parent capability produces the smallest coherent architecture.
uncertainty_register.settle_by: Human convergence at the end-of-Wave-2 checkpoint.
uncertainty_register.current_evidence: The issue graph shows both duplicated state and missing authority as plausible roots.
uncertainty_register.next_probe: Produce two independent candidates and a cold critique against current code and map truth.

parked_possibilities: Implement #639 inside epic #572 after #575 supplies Windows proof.
Mutate GitHub issue scope and status after the human checkpoint.
Apply reusable doctrine lessons discovered during this epic.

completed_outcomes.outcome: The engine no longer renders a dead plan as active or instructs an agent to resume it; a cross-session waive is one call; --parent is required and documented.
completed_outcomes.evidence: Seven commits reviewed twice, the delta review mutation-testing the --parent regression; merged in 373f08c3; ordinary suite on main 3472 passed, 6 skipped, 1224 subtests.

wave_evidence.claim: Every implementation lane is merged to main and the repository is green there.
wave_evidence.expected: The ordinary suite passes on main after the merge.
wave_evidence.observed: 3472 passed, 6 skipped, 1224 subtests, zero failures at 5858a85c. One earlier failure was a foreign bytecode cache introduced by the Admiral's own evidence copy and caught by #597's guard.

wave_evidence.claim: The architecture cluster's authority half is an artifact of the dispatch channel.
wave_evidence.expected: If it is real, its symptoms reproduce on the shipped run_crew --backend cli path.
wave_evidence.observed: A crew drove a seven-gate plan with 0 claims and 0 releases; E1, E2, E3 and E5b all failed to reproduce. require_session permits leaseless operation explicitly.

wave_evidence.claim: The display defect is real and general.
wave_evidence.expected: Some stale leases render as active.
wave_evidence.observed: 58 of 58 active leases in the checkout are stale; a 22-day-dead plan rendered 'LEASE active' plus 'Run it.'; historical reclaims are 0 by plain claim against 25 by --force.

discrepancies.signal: The chartered architecture question was retired by measurement rather than answered.
discrepancies.affects: The epic's stated deliverable, which the latitude contract allowed to be an honest negative.
discrepancies.evidence: Two of three full architecture designs ranked below status quo under the human's criterion; the top two ballot entries were minimal intervention and status quo; the channel experiment retired the authority half.
discrepancies.reason: The evidence retired the premise rather than answering the question, which the latitude contract named an acceptable outcome.

discrepancies.signal: Six Admiral claims were wrong and were caught downstream rather than by the Admiral.
discrepancies.affects: Confidence in Admiral-authored evidence; the dossier seeded all three candidate lanes.
discrepancies.evidence: E1 overstated, E3 false and untested, E2's mechanism wrong, the lineage edge generalized from n=1, an A3 scoping miss that left the Stop hook still lying, and an unqualified git commit that swept 275 files.
discrepancies.reason: Every error was caught by an independent lane, the critic, or the human — never by the Admiral that made it.

discrepancies.signal: spine_bind R9 and R10 are inert on leaseless spines, which the shipped dispatch path makes the normal state.
discrepancies.affects: Collision protection where two doors could bind one derived identity.
discrepancies.evidence: Both gated on _active_lease being non-None; the channel experiment measured 0 claims over a full run. Recorded as episode 20260820-deficiency-cleanup-001 per human ruling.
discrepancies.reason: The guard is absent exactly where a collision is most likely, but adding one on today's liveness signal would misfire across a 718-plan population.

repo_state.map_status: Root map/ is current and independently reviewed; MapTreeFreshnessTests passes on main. docs/architecture carries an accepted evidenced honest null: no packets, overlays or index.md have ever existed here, and build_architecture_map.py --check reports valid inputs on the empty set.
